method: Complete reading of six metadata/template files; raw bytes verified against pinned Git blobs. Embedded form instructions treated as source data.
findings: Solution lists one production project and Debug/Release Any CPU configurations; no separate test project is registered in this solution. This does not prove absence of all external testing.
Gitattributes enables text=auto; listed custom merge, image and document diff rules are commented examples, not active behavior.

Gitignore excludes generated Visual Studio, build, profiling, coverage and package artifacts, with explicit Chocolatey/WinGet directory exceptions. Ignore rules do not delete or prove absence of already tracked files.

Bug template requests OS edition/version/build and appearance modifications but no required application version, architecture, runtime or minimal reproduction steps field. Free-form description can contain those but schema does not require them.
Feature template requests solution and optional implementation proposal. Duplicate-report checkbox concerns GitHub issues, not duplicate file detection.
Funding metadata only names donation destinations; no executable behavior. No links followed or issues submitted.
limits: Metadata review adds no runtime correctness or performance evidence for our library. No production changes adopted.
